title: Aurora Health — private deploy quick log
content:
Daily scratchpad — runbook + TODOs for Aurora Health private deployment.

Context: first private deployment for Aurora (regional healthcare platform). Customer asked for VPC peering, KMS-backed keys, and an on-prem gateway for audit logs. They want canary rollout then 100% once smoke tests pass. Small account: start with 1 reserved node pool (2x A10G) + burst on demand.

High-level plan (quick):
- set up infra project and VPC peering -> test connectivity to Aurora dev VPC
- provision KMS key with customer-managed rotation policy
- deploy private control plane (single AZ for POC) behind customer firewall / reverse proxy
- seed model bundle (r2-small quantized) and run perf smoke tests
- configure Redwood Console read-only view for Aurora SREs

Open questions / unknowns:
- Audit log path: does Aurora want push or pull? (asked on 2025-06-11, waiting reply)
- Customer's internal Egress WG may require explicit IP allowlist for telemetry -> need static egress IPs
- Which exact KMS ARN do they want us to use? They mentioned a key in project aurora-prod-kms but access control not confirmed

Quick checklist (today):
- [x] Create infra project: redwood-aurora-poc (done)
- [x] Open peering request ticket to Aurora netops (JIRA-AUR-128)
- [ ] Confirm KMS IAM principals with customer (Diego to confirm)
- [ ] Create terraform module for VPC + peering (initial)
- [ ] Deploy private control plane (helm values prepared)
- [ ] Run canary traffic through dedicated pool (10 qps, 128 tokens avg)
- [ ] Validate logs and trace ingestion in Console

Notes / commands I used today:
- terraform workspace new aurora-poc
- terraform apply -var=project=redwood-aurora-poc -auto-approve 
  (kept minimal: VPC, subnet, route, peering resource placeholder)

- helm upgrade --install redwood-control-plane ./chart \ 
    --namespace redwood-private 
    --set ingress.enabled=false 
    --set controlPlane.replicaCount=1 
    --values values-aurora-poc.yaml

values-aurora-poc.yaml snippets (notes):
controlPlane:
  private: true
  allowedCidrs: ["10.2.0.0/16", "10.3.0.0/24"]  # Aurora dev ranges, confirm
  egressStaticIps: [] # populate after netops confirms
kms:
  useCustomerKey: true
  keyArn: "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/REPLACE_ME"

Model and runtime choices:
- Start with r2-small quantized (int8) for cost predictability
- If latency > 120ms p95, try r2-medium or enable partial KV cache for common prefixes
- Batching policy: continuousBatched=true, max_batch_tokens=2048 for throughput tests

Smoke test plan (scripted):
- run synthetic generator (1000 requests, 10 qps) against canary endpoint
- measure p50/p95, token/sec, GPU util
- check Console: token-level cost + latency breakdown
- sample 50 outputs for quality regression against golden prompts (eval set: aurora-10-prompts.json)

Troubleshooting notes:
- Observed occasional timeouts when control plane replicaCount=1 during rolling updates -> prefer canary window and pre-warm cache before cutover
- If KMS permission Denied, check: kms:GenerateDataKey permissions for ec2 role + control plane service account

Customer-facing TODOs (what I need from Aurora):
1) Confirm target VPC cidr ranges and peering contact email
2) Provide KMS key ARN + IAM binding list (principals)
3) Confirm allowed egress IPs for telemetry and Console access
4) Provide short list of 5 golden prompts for output evaluation

Notes to self / reminders:
- Keep tickets small -> split VPC peering + KMS + control-plane deploy as separate PRs for faster review
- Save a snapshot of values-aurora-poc.yaml in repo under infra/aurora/values-20250612.yaml
- Check with infra-qa about automated teardown schedule for POC cluster (avoid accidental billing)

Links / references:
- Confluence draft: confluence.redwood.internal/pages/AURORA-PRIVATE-POC (draft)
- PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/942 (tf + helm templates)
- JIRA: JIRA-AUR-128 (VPC peering)

End-of-day quick log: 2025-06-15 17:20 PT
- Spent morning on terraform skeleton + peering ticket
- Afternoon: helm values iteration + first control-plane deploy (logs noisy but up)
- Next: KMS confirmation + canary traffic tomorrow morning (09:00 PT)

Random brain dump / low-priority ideas:
- Offer Aurora a monthly audit export to S3 with object lock for compliance (feature ask)
- Consider pre-warming a small prefix cache for EHR prompts if they share common headers

If blocked -> escalate to Diego or Sofia.
